{{Top}}
[[File:Dianoga_in_Toilets.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] emerging from a toilet.]]
A '''toilet''' was a fixture found in [[Refresher/Legends|refreshers]], used for the disposal of bodily wastes. Toilet paper was used to maintain personal hygiene.<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

[[Dianoga/Legends|Dianogas]] were sometimes known to live in and crawl out of a toilet.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

[[Medical droid/Legends|Medical droids]] were sometimes reprogrammed to work as toilet cleaners in the military.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Atat_toilet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An Imperial Army pilot on the toilet in ''Robot Chicken''.]]
In ''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars]]'', an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-AT pilot]] is seen using a toilet in ''[[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]]'', where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] throws explosives into at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

In a comic strip appearing in MAD magazine's "A MAD look at Star Wars," [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] is directed to the lavatory in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], where he finds a bewildering array of urinals designed for various aliens' physiology.
